visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A retail-style blister package is centered against a clean white background. The backing card is a light beige color with the text "COFFEE TIME figure" printed at the top in a bold, dark brown font. Inside the clear plastic housing, a highly detailed corgi figure wearing a red royal guard uniform and a black maritime-style hat sits alongside several miniature accessories including a red frisbee, a blue bowl, a small striped t-shirt, and a bone-shaped treat. (2) Two human hands reach in from the lower corners of the frame, firmly gripping the sides of the cardboard packaging. They lift the entire product ensemble upwards, moving it slightly closer to the lens before the scene shifts to show the figure out of the box. (3) The corgi figurine is shown isolated from its packaging, held by a single hand against a neutral white backdrop. The figure is meticulously rotated clockwise and then counter-clockwise to showcase the craftsmanship of the red jacket, the blue sash, the golden shoulder patches, and the expressive, panting facial features of the dog character.

The tempo is moderately fast at approximately 120 BPM, creating a lighthearted and energetic atmosphere without any competing environmental noise or vocal elements. (2) The background music continues at a consistent volume while a series of sharp, plastic crinkling and sliding sounds are heard as the hands manipulate the blister packaging. These incidental noises have a high frequency range and indicate the physical movement of plastic against cardboard. (3) The electronic music remains the dominant audio layer while the figurine is rotated. Very faint, low-frequency friction sounds are audible as the fingers adjust their grip on the hard resin or plastic surface of the toy. The acoustic environment remains clean and studio-like until the end.
